description: Ghana Air Force jet trainer displayed on a concrete pad on the lawn outside the Bamfo Kwakye Building at the KNUST College of Engineering. Serial G959 read directly from a dated photograph of 7 July 2022 (Baah Thomas on Wikimedia Commons); a further dated photograph of 1 April 2023 shows it in the same position, and the airframe is present in current Google satellite imagery. Cream and red scheme with Ghana roundels and fin flash.
museum_name: Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology College of Engineering
